# OpsSTAKE

> OpsSTAKE is an independent Nigerian Naira (₦) competitive esports wagering and automated escrow arena for tactical mobile shooter players (1v1 duels and 5v5 squad matches), featuring AI scoreboard verification, real-time comms, and instant bank payouts.

Call of Duty: Mobile is a trademark of Activision Publishing, Inc. OpsSTAKE is an independent third-party esports platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Activision.

- [Interactive Platform Documentation Page](https://opsstake.online/docs): Structured web guide covering escrow mechanics, fee schedules, fair-play rules, and search engine indexing readiness.
- [Official Arena Rules & Escrow Protocols](https://opsstake.online/rules): Loadout rules, scoreboard proof protocol, stalled match policy, and repeat-offense strike penalties.

## Key Facts
- **Currency**: Nigerian Naira (NGN / ₦)
- **Escrow Model**: Two-step on-demand escrow (host creates link with ₦0 upfront; opponent stakes first; host matches stake to unlock the official Private Room Code).
- **Platform Rake**: Tiered 1v1 fees from 10% (micro-wagers under ₦2,500 pot) down to 3.5% (high-roller pots ₦100,000+). 5v5 Squad matches carry a reduced 5% base fee down to 3.0%.
- **Stalled / Abandoned Matches**: Strictly no automatic settlement or unilateral refunds. Both players must agree to restart the countdown timer or trigger a 100% mutual refund, or submit video proof to human moderators.
- **Verification**: AI-assisted scoreboard screenshot forensics plus human moderator dispute queue.
- **Real-Time Features**: World Chat, Rivals roster with live Active/Offline/Last Seen presence, 1v1 Encrypted Chat & Match Lobby Chat with Sent/Read receipts, browser voice chat, and dynamic Last-5-Match Win Streak badges.
